title: Mitochondrial complex I dysfunction in idiopathic autism: convergence to a single chronic attractor and causal resolution by dynamic perturbation
description: Reference implementation and reproducible computational pipeline (source code, closed-form calibration, continuation, cohort inverse problem, phenotype matching, dynamic discriminators, directed information flow, Monte Carlo classification, Sobol sensitivity analysis, and LaTeX equations) for resolving bioenergetic causality in idiopathic autism.
